metadata.title: KP06 · Nonlinear reduction and manifolds
metadata.description: Reasoning-led 2.3.1; editable native teaching deck; global manual mode; no narration.

degrees-title.name: degrees-title
degrees-title.text: Are coordinate count and degrees of freedom equal?

degrees-context.name: degrees-context
degrees-context.text: Observed coordinates are stored numbers. The diagram specifies a known generating rule rather than an estimated model.

degrees-source.name: degrees-source
degrees-source.text: PR · KP06 · 1/10  |  Handout §1,§2  |  Manual Next / Prev

degrees-bubble.name: degrees-bubble
degrees-bubble.text: Track independently adjustable inputs, then count the stored output coordinates.

degrees-local.name: degrees-local
degrees-local.text: Manifold: locally describable by a small set of continuous coordinates.

parabola-title.name: parabola-title
parabola-title.text: One parameter can trace a curved planar path

parabola-context.name: parabola-context
parabola-context.text: Added construction: $\mathbf x=(t,t^2)^T$. Both axes share a drawing scale; the table lists all five samples.

parabola-source.name: parabola-source
parabola-source.text: PR · KP06 · 2/10  |  Handout §3  |  Manual Next / Prev

parabola-bubble.name: parabola-bubble
parabola-bubble.text: Follow increasing t along the curve and match every sampled observation to the table.

parabola-variance-title.name: parabola-variance-title
parabola-variance-title.text: Calculate variance before choosing the PCA axis

parabola-variance-context.name: parabola-variance-context
parabola-variance-context.text: Reuse the five points with $1/5$ covariance normalization. Let $s$ denote the centered second coordinate.

parabola-variance-source.name: parabola-variance-source
parabola-variance-source.text: PR · KP06 · 3/10  |  Handout §3  |  Manual Next / Prev

parabola-variance-bubble.name: parabola-variance-bubble
parabola-variance-bubble.text: Calculate the mean, squared sums, and cross-product before selecting a direction.

collision-title.name: collision-title
collision-title.text: Does the projected coordinate identify a curve location?

collision-context.name: collision-context
collision-context.text: Inspect the direction chosen on the previous page, passing only its projected score onward.

collision-source.name: collision-source
collision-source.text: PR · KP06 · 4/10  |  Handout §3  |  Manual Next / Prev

collision-bubble.name: collision-bubble
collision-bubble.text: Follow converging arrows to find distinct inputs, then inspect another linear coordinate.

distances-title.name: distances-title
distances-title.text: Is a shortcut as long as a path along the data?

distances-context.name: distances-context
distances-context.text: Added: a unit semicircle with endpoints on its arc. Compare the same endpoint pair.

distances-source.name: distances-source
distances-source.text: PR · KP06 · 5/10  |  Handout §4  |  Manual Next / Prev

distances-bubble.name: distances-bubble
distances-bubble.text: Trace the constrained path and the interior chord, then verify their lengths.

local-chords-title.name: local-chords-title
local-chords-title.text: Why do short chords approximate the arc better?

local-chords-context.name: local-chords-context
local-chords-context.text: Use the same unit semicircle, split into four equal angular intervals measured in radians.

local-chords-source.name: local-chords-source
local-chords-source.text: PR · KP06 · 6/10  |  Handout §4,§7  |  Manual Next / Prev

local-chords-bubble.name: local-chords-bubble
local-chords-bubble.text: Add local chords one at a time, then sum their lengths and compare with the true arc.

graph-scales-title.name: graph-scales-title
graph-scales-title.text: Changing a radius can change graph paths

graph-scales-context.name: graph-scales-context
graph-scales-context.text: Added seven-point U, with unit grid spacing. All panels use identical positions and scale. Edge lengths use original Euclidean distances; radius compares distances.

graph-scales-source.name: graph-scales-source
graph-scales-source.text: PR · KP06 · 7/10  |  Handout §5  |  Manual Next / Prev

graph-scales-bubble.name: graph-scales-bubble
graph-scales-bubble.text: Compare small, intermediate, and larger radii; locate disconnections and shortcuts.

targets-title.name: targets-title
targets-title.text: Do nonlinear methods preserve the same structure?

targets-context.name: targets-context
targets-context.text: Kernel and graph views are introductory perspectives rather than exclusive categories. This is a question map for later units.

targets-source.name: targets-source
targets-source.text: PR · KP06 · 8/10  |  Handout §6  |  Manual Next / Prev

targets-bubble.name: targets-bubble
targets-bubble.text: Start with trusted relationships and read what each method asks to preserve.

conditions-title.name: conditions-title
conditions-title.text: Are parameters, distances, and labels the same success criterion?

conditions-context.name: conditions-context
conditions-context.text: Consider different objectives on the same known curve, without any real-data performance claim.

conditions-source.name: conditions-source
conditions-source.text: PR · KP06 · 9/10  |  Handout §2,§8  |  Manual Next / Prev

conditions-bubble.name: conditions-bubble
conditions-bubble.text: Track evidence needed by each evaluation and identify what an attractive plot cannot establish.

conditions-evaluation.name: conditions-evaluation
conditions-evaluation.text: Check: smoothness/sampling → neighbors/connectivity → new-point rules → predefined evaluation.

new-helix-title.name: new-helix-title
new-helix-title.text: Judge a representation on a new space curve

new-helix-context.name: new-helix-context
new-helix-context.text: Added: the diagram supplies a generator and two parameter values; dimension is not inferred from finite samples.

new-helix-source.name: new-helix-source
new-helix-source.text: PR · KP06 · 10/10  |  Handout §9  |  Manual Next / Prev

new-helix-bubble.name: new-helix-bubble
new-helix-bubble.text: Find ambient/intrinsic dimensions and the collision using only the first two coordinates. Must every linear projection fail?

new-helix-linear.name: new-helix-linear
new-helix-linear.text: A linear choice still works: retain $x_3=t$.
